Description: Erforge CLI - AI-powered coding assistant Usage: ErforgeCli [command] [options] Options: -p, --prompt

Run in one-shot non-interactive mode with the given prompt -c, --continue Continue the most recent session -r, --resume Resume a specific session by ID --add-dir Add directories to context --agent Use a specific sub-agent type --model Select AI model --config Override config file path --provider AI provider: auto, anthropic, openai, or ollama (default: auto) --output-format Output format: text, json, or stream-json --dangerously-skip-permissions Bypass permission prompts --permission-mode Permission mode: default, plan, or bypass --append-system-prompt Append text to the system prompt --allowedTools Comma-separated list of allowed tools --disallowedTools Comma-separated list of denied tools -v, --verbose Show HTTP requests, endpoints, and token usage -?, -h, --help Show help and usage information --version Show version information Commands: init Create an ERFORGE.md project memory file mcp MCP server management update Self-update Erforge CLI
